patch.value: The monolithic in-memory pipeline (O1) is expected to be within performance limits for an assumed ~1,000-note target, pending confirmation of Q3. K4 and K5 mitigations (streaming, chunked index loading) would add complexity without benefit at smaller scales. R22 SHOULD performance target (500 ms search) is validated in M4.

O1 (monolithic CLI pipeline) is the best fit for this project's focused scope, single-user orientation, and desire for fast time-to-value. It satisfies every MUST requirement with the least upfront design overhead. The single-process, in-memory approach is expected to be within performance limits for an assumed ~1,000-note scale (pending Q3 confirmation). The main trade-off—limited extensibility compared to O2's plugin architecture—is acceptable because the project's non-goals explicitly exclude features that would demand a plugin ecosystem (e.g., multi-user, AI generation, mobile apps). O3 (SSG wrapper) was rejected because it couples the project to an external SSG's release cadence and makes standalone distribution harder. O4 (multi-stage pipeline with intermediate artifacts) adds complexity for incremental builds that are only a COULD requirement (R23).
